physical_subject: When does combining two predictions help?
relationship: For two scalar predictions and any fixed target, average squared loss minus squared loss of the average equals (a−b)²/4. It need not beat the better model.
operation: A chord and convex squared-error curve separate average loss from loss of average; the target moves to expose the limitation.
closest_prior: Earlier loss, bias-variance and crowds films
substantive_difference: Pointwise convexity guarantee for two scalar predictions; explicitly distinguishes average loss from the best model.
